name: isolated_ccz_measured_and_gadget_lowering
precondition: family dv_recon (Toffoli-level IRCircuit); needs toffoli and ancilla_room; at least one ccz or ccx op; n_qubits <= 24. No requirement that any two Toffolis share controls, lie in a run, or form a compute/uncompute pair - this is what separates it from and_ancilla_ccz_lowering_with_measured_uncompute, whose run-with-shared-control-pair trigger evidently fired nowhere here (current T = 119 = 7 x 17 exactly, i.e. every one of the 17 ccz is still paying the full 7-T decomposition even though shared_control_pairs = 7, so the controls are rewritten or Hadamard-cut between the members of every candidate run).
identity: Lower ONE Toffoli at a time, in place, with a single clean ancilla borrowed only for the three consecutive ops of its own gadget. For ccz(x,y,z): a = and_compute(x,y) [4 T, ancilla a in |0> -> |x AND y>]; cz(a,z); and_uncompute(a; x,y) [0 T: measure a in the X basis, and on outcome s = 1 apply a classically controlled cz(x,y)]. For ccx(x,y,z) emit h(z), the same three ops with cx(a,z) replaced by cz(a,z) under the Hadamards, h(z) - equivalently h(z) ccz-gadget h(z). Because the gadget's ancilla lifetime is three adjacent ops, ONE clean ancilla (qubit index n, from append_ancillas(c, 1)) is reused by all 17 gadgets sequentially; nothing else in the circuit touches it, so no scheduling conflict can arise and the qubit count rises by exactly 1 regardless of how many Toffolis are lowered. Hadamards, X gates and CXs elsewhere in the op list are untouched - the rewrite is strictly local to each Toffoli's own position, so the heavy H interleaving of this circuit (30 h, 'h ccz h' x11) cannot block it, unlike any diagonal-segment / phase-polynomial route.
correctness: and_compute is Jones' 2013 Toffoli-with-one-ancilla construction (equivalently Gidney's temporary AND): it prepares |x AND y> on a clean ancilla using 4 T gates (T-count 4 via one CCZ/T-state injection with a measured correction), exactly, for all computational-basis x,y. Then cz(a,z) multiplies the state by (-1)^{(x AND y) z} = (-1)^{xyz}, which is exactly CCZ's action. The measured uncompute is exact rather than approximate: measuring a in the X basis on the state |x AND y> leaves no entanglement with the data (a is in a computational basis state conditioned on x,y), and the outcome s yields a residual deterministic phase (-1)^{s (x AND y)} = (-1)^{s x y}, which is a quadratic form removed exactly by the classically controlled cz(x,y) - a Clifford, zero T. Hence for each measurement branch s, K_s |x,y,z,...> = c_s |CCZ(x,y,z)...> with c_s = 1 for both branches (same constant for all inputs, so phase consistency holds, invariant 2) and sum_s |c_s|^2 = 1 over the two equiprobable branches; the ancilla starts and ends in |0> after the X-basis measurement is reset (the gadget's declared contract |0> -> |0>). No angles, no error: error_class exact, nothing drawn from the ledger. The frozen judge's branch-wise specification check is exactly the statement proved above, and the whole-circuit check compares against the ORIGINAL 7-T-per-Toffoli circuit.
trigger: Scan the op list for every gate g with name in {ccz, ccx} on three distinct qubits. Emit one match per such gate, keyed by its index, provided (i) a clean ancilla is available (append one if the circuit has no spare; its three gadget ops are contiguous so the same index serves every match) and (ii) the gate is not already covered by an and_ancilla_ccz_lowering run that the existing accepted rule rewrote in the same pass (check by index ownership, so the two rules never double-lower the same Toffoli). Matches are applied one at a time and priced before verification, so any Toffoli whose local rewrite does not lower T is simply dropped. Expected: 17 matches on this circuit.
expected_effect: Each lowered ccz goes from the 7-T Clifford+T decomposition to 4 T (and_compute) + 0 T (cz) + 0 T (measured uncompute) = 4 T, saving 3 T per gate; the 30 h, 24 x and 3 cx are unchanged and contribute no T. 17 ccz x 3 T = 51 T removed, taking 119 -> 68 at the cost of exactly 1 clean ancilla (11 -> 12 qubits) and 17 mid-circuit measurements with classically controlled CZ fix-ups. 68 < 73, so this clears the best baseline (pyzx) on the lever pyzx cannot use at all, since pyzx's 73 is a unitary ancilla-free Clifford+T number and the fingerprint leaves rotation_count / angle_cost / algebraic_structure at zero headroom while ancilla_reconstruction has all 17 Toffolis of headroom left. Even if a handful of gadgets are rejected, each accepted one pays 3 T independently - the saving degrades linearly rather than all-or-nothing.
source: C. Jones, 'Low-overhead constructions for the fault-tolerant Toffoli gate', Phys. Rev. A 87, 022328 (2013) (Toffoli at T-count 4 with one ancilla and a measured correction); C. Gidney, 'Halving the cost of quantum addition', Quantum 2, 74 (2018) (temporary-AND / measurement-based uncompute at zero T with a classically controlled Clifford fix-up).
